title: Draw the path
prompt: The robot's path is an array of distances. For each one, move forward that far and then turn left. [30, 40] gives forward 30, left, forward 40, left.
hints: The loop variable is the distance for this leg.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left.
